atoms.b: In London, there are people from many different places. Khaled, from the Middle East, likes the city's busy feel. ((Although)) the streets are crowded, he feels happy in the mix of cultures. Down his street lives Maria, from Latin America, she paints pictures. ((Though)) the colours are not very bright, her paintings show that many people belong to the city. Raj, from Asia, makes friends easily. ((While)) his own culture is very conservative, he likes meeting new people from other cultures. ((Even if)) they speak different languages, Raj always finds ways to connect. In this city, where everyone is different, they all come together. ((Although)) the backgrounds are contrasting, the city celebrates these differences.
